description: This walk follows a section of the Thames Path from Shiplake to Henley in Oxfordshire. The route runs for just under 4 miles, following the waymarked National Trail north between the two settlements. Part of the route follows riverside paths while there is also a section through Lower Shiplake. Along the way there are splendid views over the river to the surrounding countryside and hills.
